summary: Admin-tunable sign-in security: the login lockout gains configurable threshold, counting window, and lock duration, and the strong-password rule gains a configurable minimum length (System Settings, Access & Security, revealed under their parent toggles). The static password help bullets were replaced by the live on-entry checklist card, which now always appears under new-password fields and adapts to the active policy. The 2FA verification page was also reworked to follow the configured login style, fit its card, and use icon buttons with tooltips. New data-protection surfaces: an operator-configurable privacy-policy/terms link and notice on the sign-in and sign-up pages, an optional required consent checkbox at sign-up, and a Data & Privacy docs page listing exactly what personal data DjangoLux stores. No migrations; inline-safe.
highlights: Login lockout is now tunable: attempts before lock, counting window, and lock duration.
Strong passwords gain a configurable minimum length (8-64, default 12).
New-password fields now always show the live requirements checklist, matching the active policy.
The 2FA verification page now matches your login style, fits its card, and uses tidy icon buttons.
New privacy controls: show a privacy-policy link on the sign-in/sign-up pages and optionally require a consent checkbox at sign-up.
